title: Navy + Gold luxury rebrand with premium header, logo integration, refined typography, buttons, cards, and subtle texture

requirements.summary: Replace global Dark Leather design tokens with the exact Navy + Gold palette via CSS variables and Tailwind theme so the entire frontend inherits the new colors without bright-blue defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: Global background renders as dark navy (not brown/maroon) and primary accent renders as gold across all pages (Home, Products, Category, Catalogue, About, Contact).
Text is soft-cream on dark backgrounds with sufficient contrast; muted text is visibly subdued but readable.
Borders/dividers use muted gold tones rather than heavy/bright outlines.
No UI elements default to bright blue (links, focus states, buttons) unless explicitly part of the navy/gold system.

file_operations.description: Update global CSS variables to map background/card/secondary/primary/muted/border/ring to the exact new palette (Background #0F1B2D, Secondary Dark #141F33, Gold Accent #C8A24D, Soft Cream Text #F4EFE6, Muted Gold Divider #B9933C). Update focus/interactive styles to avoid browser default bright blue (e.g., ring/link focus) while keeping accessible contrast.

Align Tailwind theme usage with the updated CSS variables so existing utility classes (bg-background, text-foreground, border-border, text-muted-foreground, bg-card, text-primary, ring-primary, etc.) reflect the navy+gold system; adjust/remove legacy 'leather/gold/beige' extension colors where they conflict with the new palette to prevent drift and accidental bright-blue styling.

If this stylesheet is used anywhere in the build, update its base theme tokens to match the same navy+gold palette and focus states as frontend/src/index.css so no pages fall back to a mismatched color system.

requirements.summary: Upgrade the header to a premium luxury navigation with transparent/overlay treatment on the Home hero, subtle blur, refined spacing/typography, and gold underline active state while keeping mobile nav accessible.
acceptanceCriteria: On the Home page, the header overlays the hero image with a subtle blur and does not appear as a flat opaque bar.
Active nav item is indicated via a subtle gold underline/marker (not a solid filled background) on both desktop and mobile menus.
Mobile menu open/close remains accessible (aria-label preserved) and readable on dark navy background.
Logo area and navigation have noticeably more breathing room than current header height/spacing.

file_operations.description: Refactor header styling to support a Home-only transparent/overlay variant (with backdrop blur) and a standard solid variant for other pages; increase vertical padding/spacing, use thinner/refined nav typography, and replace the active-state filled pill with a gold underline/marker for both desktop and mobile menus while preserving the existing mobile toggle aria-label.
Adjust the Home hero section spacing (e.g., top padding / stacking context) so the upgraded transparent header overlays the hero cleanly without layout jump or content collision.

requirements.summary: Integrate the provided MeghRaj Exports logo into the header top-left with premium sizing, padding, and retina-sharp rendering using generated static assets.
acceptanceCriteria: Header shows the MeghRaj Exports logo at top-left on desktop and mobile.
Logo is not cramped: padding/clear space is present around it, and it does not collide with nav/menu button.
Logo remains readable on dark background and does not appear as a white rectangle pasted on the page (transparent/clean edge handling).

file_operations.description: Add the generated transparent-background logo asset as a static file (do not serve via backend) for use in the header on lighter areas if needed.
Add the generated gold-only logo variant (static asset) optimized for dark navy backgrounds for primary header usage.
Add the generated simplified square mark (static asset) for small/compact usage (e.g., mobile or tight header states).

Replace/augment the text-only site name with an using the generated logo assets, ensuring correct sizing, adequate padding/clear space, and crisp rendering on high-DPI displays; keep navigation alignment balanced across breakpoints.

requirements.summary: Refine site-wide button styling into a consistent premium system (gold primary, gold outline secondary, invert on hover/focus, subtle elevation) across key CTAs.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary CTA buttons render with gold fill and navy text by default.
Hover/focus states invert colors smoothly (no jarring animations) and maintain accessibility (visible focus ring aligned to the theme).
Buttons across Home, Category, Catalogue, Contact pages follow a consistent style system (shape, radius, typography, shadow).

file_operations.description: Define reusable button style utilities/components via Tailwind layers (e.g., shared classes for primary and secondary buttons) using the new theme tokens; ensure hover/focus-visible includes theme-aligned ring and smooth transitions without bright-blue defaults.
Update the 'View Products', 'Request Catalogue', and 'Contact Us' buttons to use the shared premium button style utilities for consistent gold/navy invert behavior and subtle elevation.
Update 'Send Inquiry' and 'Back to Products' actions to match the shared premium button style system (primary and secondary as appropriate) with consistent hover/focus.
Update 'Request Catalogue' CTA to use the shared premium button styles and ensure focus/hover states invert within the navy+gold system.
Update 'Send Inquiry' and 'Submit Another Inquiry' buttons to use shared premium button styles including disabled styling aligned to the theme (no default blue focus).

requirements.summary: Reduce boxy feel on cards/blocks by removing heavy borders, using subtler shadows, refined gold detailing, and subtle hover interactions (slight zoom + soft gold glow).
acceptanceCriteria: Cards (e.g., Home highlights, Products category cards) no longer rely on thick borders to define shape; they use shadow and background separation instead.
Hover interactions are subtle and consistent (no large scaling); visual emphasis is via soft gold glow/accent.
Section titles that represent major content blocks can show thin gold dividers/separators consistent with #B9933C/#C8A24D.

file_operations.description: Adjust/extend shadows and theme-friendly glow utilities (via boxShadow or custom colors tied to CSS variables) to enable subtle premium card elevation and gold-tinted hover glow without introducing harsh outlines.
Refine category cards to reduce border emphasis, apply subtler base shadow, and add restrained hover interaction (slight scale + soft gold glow) while keeping motion subtle and consistent.
Update highlight cards to remove boxy border feel, use refined shadows/background separation, and unify hover treatment to the new premium system.
Refine the 'Customization Note' block (and other key blocks) to avoid heavy borders; use muted-gold detailing and premium shadow separation.

Update accordion item styling to remove heavy borders, use softer shadows and subtle separators, and ensure hover states match the refined premium card language. Use the shadcn-ui Accordion component already in use to support the hierarchy UI; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Improve typography hierarchy for a luxury feel: stronger serif headings, lighter/airier body text, refined nav typography, consistent across pages and components.
acceptanceCriteria: Headings read as premium editorial serif (existing serif is acceptable) with stronger hierarchy than current (more differentiation between H1/H2/H3).
Body copy has improved readability via line-height and spacing; no cramped paragraphs.
Navigation typography appears thinner/more refined than current while remaining readable.

file_operations.description: Tune global typography defaults: heading sizes/weights/letter-spacing for clearer H1/H2/H3 hierarchy, and body font weight/line-height/paragraph spacing for a more premium, airy reading experience; ensure form labels and small text remain readable on dark backgrounds.
Refine navigation typography to be thinner/more premium (e.g., weight, tracking, casing if appropriate) while maintaining legibility and consistent spacing across breakpoints.
Ensure content typography (section headings and body paragraphs) aligns with the new global hierarchy and spacing expectations (no cramped blocks; consistent serif heading treatment).
Align form label/input/validation typography with the refined hierarchy (lighter body, clear labels, consistent spacing) while preserving accessibility and readability.

requirements.summary: Add subtle luxury detailing: thin gold separators, small gold accent markers for lists, and a very subtle leather-like texture overlay (~5% opacity) on main dark backgrounds.
acceptanceCriteria: Major page sections can be visually separated with thin gold lines/gradients consistent with the theme (not heavy rules).
Backgrounds show subtle texture depth (barely visible) and do not reduce text readability.
Texture overlay is subtle and not distracting; it remains consistent across pages using the main background.

file_operations.description: Add the generated seamless subtle leather texture tile as a static asset (do not serve via backend) to be used for a low-opacity overlay on dark navy backgrounds.

Implement a consistent, barely-visible (~5% opacity) background texture overlay using frontend/public/assets/generated/leather-texture-tile.dim_1024x1024.png and add reusable utilities for thin muted-gold separators and gold list markers while ensuring readability is not reduced.
Wire the global background texture/separator styling into the top-level layout so it applies consistently across pages that use the main background.
Add refined thin gold divider detailing under the main page title/section heading (where appropriate) using the new separator utilities, consistent with muted gold tones.
Update list bullets/markers to use small gold accent markers (muted gold) and ensure section separation uses thin gold rules rather than heavy borders.

Update product type list markers to use small gold accent markers consistent with the theme and ensure separators/dividers are thin and muted (not heavy rules). Use the shadcn-ui Accordion component already in use to support the hierarchy UI; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
